cve_summary: network.c in Aircrack-ng before 1.2 Beta 3 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (segmentation fault) via a response with a crafted length parameter.
docstring:
Summary: Retrieves data from a network socket and updates the provided buffer length.

Parameters:
s (int): The socket descriptor to read from.
arg (void*): Pointer to the buffer where the data will be stored.
len (int*): Pointer to an integer that holds the maximum length of the buffer and will be updated with the actual length of the data read.

Returns:
int: The type of the data read from the socket, or -1 on error.

Logic: The function first reads a header from the socket to determine the length of the incoming data. It checks if the length is valid and updates the provided length pointer. If the length is greater than zero, it attempts to read the actual data into the provided buffer. If any read operation fails, it returns -1. Otherwise, it returns the type of the data read.
